consumer: An ordinary account runs the installed account-parameterized Agility worker scripts/agility-order.ts with course gnome to a finite target level. One practice run of the real CLI shows Agility XP gain toward the target, eats owned food when HP is low, reconciles unrelated assets, refuses an unsupported target or entry with a clear message, and confirms logout. Release covers the Gnome course only. Wilderness and Barbarian code stays in place without live qualification. The shared boat helper and foodcourier behavior are unchanged. The finite live consumer is PickpockDick Agility 82->99 on Gnome. Its next goal is the Agility 40 thieves toward the next band. Protected accounts stay offline.
